name: http-runner
description: http-runner: runs VS Code REST Client .http files for the agent and returns the API's real reply, saved with secrets masked under http-replies/. It can write a starting .http file from a local OpenAPI file. The user types each host's login once on a local page the server opens. Needs the http-runner binary.

binPath.title: http-runner binary
binPath.description: Path to the http-runner binary. Default: http-runner on PATH.
